content.short: Alchemy Pay is a fiat-to-crypto gateway that allows users to buy TON using credit cards and bank transfers.
content.description: Alchemy Pay is a leading global payment solution provider that bridges the gap between fiat and crypto economies. Its powerful on-ramp and off-ramp services allow users to buy Toncoin (TON) and other digital assets using traditional payment methods such as credit cards, mobile wallets, and bank transfers across over 170 countries. By providing a seamless and compliant gateway, Alchemy Pay significantly lowers the barrier to entry for new users joining the TON ecosystem, making it easier than ever for the general public to acquire and use Toncoin.
content.meta: Buy TON with fiat easily using Alchemy Pay. Global credit card and bank support on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
